_comment: One-time setup the next app release asks installed studios to run (desktop/src/setup-steps.ts), read by `npm run publish -- app`. A step runs once per computer, by its id: give a changed step a new id. 'bundle' runs a setup function of the studio's own (backend/src/studio-app.ts); 'package' downloads an npm package here, ships its tarball inside the release, and unpacks it into the learner's workspaces, e.g. { "id": "faker-9.9.0", "kind": "package", "name": "@faker-js/faker", "version": "9.9.0" }.
